text:
jordan: quick flag  we need clearer guardrails for simulator runs in console. customers keep asking about "does this change route to dedicated vs hosted?"

ashley: totally. our current role editor shows permissions but not the downstream routing/quota impact. a lot of support noise.

ben: tech question: should the UI call a `simulate/quick` (cached hints) for instant feedback and `simulate/full` for detailed reports?

luisa: +1 to two endpoints. quick should be bounded (<=5 sample reqs, 200ms). full should be async and produce a report URL.

megan: UX: show a tiny "impact" chip next to each role change: green/yellow/red and a tooltip with a one-line explanation. clicking expands full diff.

jordan: security: simulator must never use live quotas. use read-only snapshot of policy+quota state. snapshots created at rollout and on-demand (enterprise).

ben: implementation note: add `snapshot_id` param to simulate endpoints. default to `current:safe` which is a recent snapshot. candidate snapshots can be derived locally in UI but must be uploaded if we run full sim.

ashley: RBAC gating: visibility of simulator = `console:simulate:view`, ability to run full/async = `console:simulate:run`. default hide for non-admins.

luisa: rate-limits: per-org token bucket, default 10 quick-runs/min, 2 full-runs/hr. enterprise customers can request higher through billing flag.

ops-bot: Reminder: record these limits in infra-limits doc and emit metric `simulator.calls` with tags {mode, org, snapshot_age}.

ben: API sketch:
POST /api/v1/simulate/quick
body: { snapshot_id: "snap-111", principal: "user:alice", change: { add_role: "reader:dedicated" }, sample: [{path: "/v1/chat", tokens: 64}] }
resp: { route_hint: "hosted-us", quota_ok: true, est_cost_delta: 0.002 }

POST /api/v1/simulate/full -> returns { run_id }
GET /api/v1/simulate/full/{run_id} -> { status, report_url, summary: [...]}

jordan: logging/audit: all sims must append an audit record with non-identifying principal_hash and snapshot_ids. full sims should create an immutable report artifact linked in audit.

megan: export: CSV with columns: principal, route_before, route_after, quota_before, quota_after, est_cost_delta. allow download from report page.

ashley: SLOs: quick preview should be <500ms 95th for responsiveness. full-run SLA can be best-effort but we should provide ETA. show a countdown on UI.

luisa: cost control: full runs consume a small billing unit. default free up to 5 runs/org/mo, then billed at low rate or charged against credits. enterprise can opt-in to unlimited.

ben: compatibility: add `simulate` events to telemetry and a client lib shim. SDK team needs to understand run_id semantics for polling. devex-bot: please RFC.

ops-bot: Action: open RFC-XXX for simulate API and feature flags. tag @sdk-team @billing @security.

jordan: small UX caveat: when showing diff, prefer to show route "buckets" not internal hostnames. e.g., "Dedicated: GPU-Pool-3 (eu-west)" -> display as "Dedicated (eu-west)".

megan: accessibility: diff table must have a text-only view and aria labels for heatmap cells.

ashley: we'll also need an admin-facing toggle: "Allow users with simulate:view to run quick previews". default off for self-serve orgs.

luisa: queueing: full-run jobs go to low-priority queue; add a cap on concurrent full runs per org (default 3). if exceeded return HTTP 429 with retry-after.

ben: edge-case: simulator should detect stale snapshots. if snapshot_age > 24h warn user and force explicit confirmation for full run.

jordan: consensus on action items:
- ben: implement endpoints + snapshot param + audit records
- luisa: define rate limits, queue caps, billing hooks
- ashley: RBAC spec + console flags + microcopy
- megan: UI chips, diff page, export, accessibility
- ops-bot: add telemetry metrics and RFC reminder

ops-bot: NOTE: link RFC to release checklist; feature flag required behind `simulator-ui` rollout flag.

megan: i'll mock the chip states and report page, will post Figma link here when ready.

jordan: thanks all. if no objections i'll file the RFC today and start a small proto for quick-preview in console. :thumbsup:
